description: This file defines a class 'VectorStorePreCallHook' which integrates vector store search functionality into a language modeling pipeline. It handles pre-call hooks to perform vector store searches, append search context to messages, and incorporates search results into responses. The class is designed to facilitate context retrieval and annotation in language model interactions, specifically in a framework using the litellm library.

classes.name: VectorStorePreCallHook
classes.description: A custom logger class that performs vector store searches before executing LLM calls, appends search results as context in messages, and handles response modifications to include search data.
